reason: Nobody I know is using this yet. It's only for 10 founding shops, so I'd be the one testing it on my own boys, and I don't do that. The free month and paying only if they use it is fair, but I'm not giving up my time to be the first one.
objection: My technicians will not use an app; they barely read English. Talking in Tamil sounds easier, but I've seen them drop every app after one week, and when the summer rush comes nobody will press any button.
would_change_my_mind: If a shop owner I trust, or my spares distributor, tells me his technicians have been using it through a full summer and it actually works.
